packages/checkpoint/src/install.ts.message: On Windows, rename replaces the target DACL with the temp file’s inherited ACL; `mode` does not preserve it. A restrictive settings file can expose env secrets to the parent ACL.
`statSync` follows a settings.json symlink, but atomic rename replaces the link itself. Dotfile-managed settings lose their link despite the command promising to change only statusLine.

packages/checkpoint/src/state.ts.message: Any string is accepted for `since`, so `{state:"armed",since:"not-a-date"}` becomes valid state. Future mtime/timeout consumers can misbehave instead of treating the store as corrupt.
